findings_to_judge.finding: MongoDB's contracted remaining performance obligation stood at $1,458.6m at 30 Apr 2026 against $774.3m a year earlier (+88%) while revenue grew 25%, with the duration lengthening (53% due in the next 12 months vs 58% a year ago; 46% in 13-36 months vs 38%) and non-current deferred revenue up from $24.3m to $91.2m — so committed next-12-month revenue rose roughly 72% YoY, a visibility base far larger than the market's pure 'Atlas consumption' framing assumes and the main reason a bigger-than-usual FY27 raise is mechanically available.
findings_to_judge.source_date: 2026-04-30 (period end; reported in the 10-Q at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001441816/000162828026039150/mdb-20260430.htm, prior-year figure at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1441816/000144181625000118/mdb-20250430.htm)

findings_to_judge.finding: The quarter being reported (fiscal Q2, May-July 2026) is precisely MongoDB's go-to-market handover quarter: incoming CRO Ryan Mac Ban started 27 Apr 2026 and the 24 Mar 2026 release states 'Outgoing CRO Paul Capombassis will support a seamless transition to Mac Ban through Q2', while the President of Field Operations, Cedric Pech, resigned effective 15 Apr 2026 and product leadership was split into two new Chief Product Officers on 22 Apr 2026 — i.e. a full field-and-product leadership rebuild landing inside the reported quarter, with a new CEO only ten months in.
